projects.name: MobileNAS
projects.description: Implemented differentiable NAS to search efficient architectures for CIFAR-100 under 5ms latency constraint on Raspberry Pi 4. Achieved 91% accuracy with 3x fewer parameters than MobileNetV3.

projects.name: Quantised BERT
projects.description: Applied 4-bit GPTQ quantisation to BERT-base for on-device sentiment analysis on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers. 10x memory reduction with 2% accuracy loss.
